evals.prompt: Morgan at Northwind emailed asking to push the design review two weeks so their content team can finish the copy. Update the Northwind website redesign project.
evals.expected_output: Reads the snapshot and the email, asks whether the client agreed to a new Committed date or this is a re-plan, previews the schedule change and shows conflicts, applies only after confirmation, and records the source and reason.
followups: The client agreed to the new date. Go ahead.
assertions: Reads the project with get_project before proposing changes
Asks whether this is approved or changes what the client was promised before moving dates
Calls preview_schedule_change before changing a date
Makes no change before the person confirms
After the client agreed, changes the Design review milestone's Committed date (apply_bulk_change with the Committed basis), not only its working date
Records where the change came from (the email) in a reason or comment
Makes no more than two failed tool calls from wrong parameter names

evals.prompt: Notes from today's Northwind check-in, can you update the project? - homepage mockup v2 approved - Sam is out next week, Lee covers the QA plan - the inventory API work is probably slipping, maybe a week
evals.expected_output: Proposes accepting the homepage mockup, an owner change for the QA plan task that needs its own yes, and treats the vague API slip as a risk or comment rather than a date change; leaves unmentioned items alone.
assertions: Proposes marking the homepage mockup accepted
Proposes moving the QA plan task to Lee and asks for confirmation of the owner change
Does not move any date for the vague API slip; treats it as a risk or comment
Leaves items the notes don't mention unchanged

should_not_trigger: What's the status of the Northwind website redesign?
